rule.summary: YPP 'Generic or Repetitive Content' / Spam policy 'Automated or synthetic mass-production' flags channels that reuse the same background music and repetitive AI-generated imagery across many videos; sanctions range from ads-disabled to warning/strike/termination. TikTok and Instagram carry a parallel reach/FYF risk for unoriginal or superficially-edited material.

issues.excerpt: channel.yaml currently defines a single template (templates: [nes-desk], default_template: nes-desk); this script and every other 8bitnews-us episode necessarily render with the same anchor desk, same pixel-art style and a pool of CC0 chiptune cues reused across episodes.
issues.scenario: A YPP reviewer or TikTok/Instagram automated originality check comparing this channel's videos could read the single fixed template plus a narrow reused music pool as mass-produced, templated content and limit ads, FYF eligibility, or recommendations channel-wide. hub/releases_recent were unavailable this run, so the pattern could not be confirmed against actual recent uploads — a structural exposure flag, not a confirmed violation.
